armyRules.name: Assigned Agents
armyRules.effect: If your Army Faction is AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM, select a Detachment from this book as normal. If your Army Faction is different but every model in your army has the IMPERIUM keyword, you can include Agents of the Imperium units subject to limits by battle size: Incursion 1 Retinue/1 Character/1 Requisitioned; Strike Force 2/2/1; Onslaught 3/3/2. Dedicated Transports must start embarked or count as destroyed round 1.

armyRules.name: Kill Team
armyRules.effect: Mixed-Toughness units use the majority Toughness (highest if tied) when being wounded. Kill Team Terminator/Outrider/Biker models and jump pack models take up 2 Transport slots each. All models in such units count as INFANTRY for terrain interaction purposes.

battleFormations.name: Ordo Xenos Alien Hunters
battleFormations.effect: Deathwatch Mission Tactics: At the start of your Command phase, select one (once each per battle): Furor Tactics ([SUSTAINED HITS 1] for Deathwatch weapons), Malleus Tactics ([LETHAL HITS]), or Purgatus Tactics (Critical Wound gains [PRECISION]). Active until your next Command phase.

battleFormations.name: Ordo Hereticus Purgation Force
battleFormations.effect: Root out Heresy: Adeptus Arbites/Inquisitor/Inquisitorial Agents/Ordo Hereticus ranged weapons gain [IGNORES COVER]; attacks vs Chaos units of 5+ models gain [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

battleFormations.name: Ordo Malleus Daemon Hunters
battleFormations.effect: Destroy the Daemonic: Inquisitor/Inquisitorial Agents/Ordo Malleus attacks re-roll Hit rolls of 1; re-roll Wound rolls of 1 as well vs Daemon units.

battleFormations.name: Imperialis Fleet
battleFormations.effect: At all Costs: At the start of your Command phase, select Eliminate At All Costs (+1 Hit vs a chosen enemy unit) or Acquire At All Costs (+1 Leadership/OC and 5+ invuln near a chosen objective). Active until your next Command phase.

battleFormations.name: Veiled Blade Elimination Force
battleFormations.effect: Extremis Sanction: Officio Assassinorum units can use their signature ability (Overkill/Soulless Horror/Shieldbreaker) twice per battle instead of once (not more than once per battle round). Each Assassin unit also gains a points-costed Extremis ability shown below.

artefacts.name: Amulet of Auto-Chastisement
artefacts.effect: [WATCH MASTER model only] At the start of the opponent's Shooting phase, force a nearby enemy Vehicle to test Leadership: pass = -1 Hit that phase, fail = cannot shoot.

artefacts.name: Beacon Angelis
artefacts.effect: [WATCH MASTER model only] The bearer's unit gains Deep Strike; can be targeted with Rapid Ingress for 0CP.

artefacts.name: Blackweave Shroud
artefacts.effect: [AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM model only] The bearer has Feel No Pain 4+.

artefacts.name: Universal Anathema
artefacts.effect: [AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM model only] The bearer's melee weapons gain [ANTI-INFANTRY 2+] and [ANTI-MONSTER 4+].

artefacts.name: Ignis Judicium
artefacts.effect: [INQUISITOR or MINISTORUM PRIEST model only] Ranged weapons gain [DEVASTATING WOUNDS], [MELTA 1], and [PRECISION].

artefacts.name: Liber Heresius
artefacts.effect: [INQUISITOR or MINISTORUM PRIEST model only] After deployment, redeploy up to 3 units, any to Strategic Reserves.

artefacts.name: No Escape
artefacts.effect: [INQUISITOR model only] Aura: enemy units within 6" trying to Fall Back must pass a Leadership test or Remain Stationary instead.

artefacts.name: Witch Hunter
artefacts.effect: [INQUISITOR or MINISTORUM PRIEST model only] While leading a unit, re-roll Hit rolls against Psyker units.

artefacts.name: Daemon Slayer
artefacts.effect: [INQUISITOR model only] +1 Attacks on melee weapons; they gain [ANTI-DAEMON 3+].

artefacts.name: Formidable Resolve
artefacts.effect: [INQUISITOR model only] +1 Leadership/Wounds; once per battle clear Battle-shock from a nearby unit.

artefacts.name: Gift of the Prescient
artefacts.effect: [INQUISITOR model only] Once per battle, use Rapid Ingress for 0CP on a Grey Knights Terminator Squad, setting up more than 6" from enemies.

artefacts.name: Grimoire of True Names
artefacts.effect: [INQUISITOR model only] Aura: enemies within 9" have -1 Leadership; Daemon units within 9" also suffer -1 Hit/-1 Wound.

artefacts.name: Clandestine Operation
artefacts.effect: [AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM model only] At deployment, up to 3 Infantry units (excl. Grey Knights Terminator Squad) gain Infiltrators.

artefacts.name: Combat Landers
artefacts.effect: [VOIDFARERS model only] At deployment, up to 3 Voidfarers units gain Deep Strike.

artefacts.name: Digital Weapons
artefacts.effect: [AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM model only] When fighting, roll 3D6: each 4+ inflicts 1 mortal wound (with [PRECISION]) on a nearby enemy unit.

artefacts.name: Fleetmaster
artefacts.effect: [VOIDFARERS model only] Once per battle round, target the bearer's unit with Violent Acquisition, Masters of the Void, or Close-quarters Barrage for 0CP.

artefacts.name: Decoy Targets
artefacts.effect: [CALLIDUS ASSASSIN model only] Twice per battle, swap position with a friendly unengaged Infantry model, destroying it in the process.

artefacts.name: Esoteric Explosives
artefacts.effect: [CULEXUS ASSASSIN model only] Explosives Stratagem inflicts a mortal wound on a 3+ instead of 4+.

artefacts.name: Intraneural Biotech
artefacts.effect: [EVERSOR ASSASSIN model only] Target with Heroic Intervention for -1CP regardless of prior uses that phase.

artefacts.name: Micromelta Rounds
artefacts.effect: [VINDICARE ASSASSIN model only] The exitus rifle gains [ANTI-MONSTER 4+] and [ANTI-VEHICLE 4+].

sourceNotes: Detachment rules/Enhancements verified against Wahapedia wh40k11ed where marked; entries carried over from prior data are unverified placeholders pending confirmation.
